title: House
tagline: A steady pulse built for shared rooms and long nights.
summary: House music emerged from Black, Latino, and queer dance communities in Chicago, then developed through clubs, records, and DJs across the world. A four-beat pulse, looping parts, and soulful or synthetic details give producers room to shape a journey. House is a broad family rather than a single formula, with local scenes continually changing its tempos, textures, and emotional character.

pillars.name: Frankie Knuckles
pillars.why: Knuckles helped shape the Chicago club sound through influential DJ sets and productions.

pillars.name: Marshall Jefferson
pillars.why: Jefferson's records helped define the musical vocabulary of early Chicago house.

pillars.name: Larry Heard
pillars.why: Heard brought introspective harmony and atmosphere to house, expanding its emotional range.
